evidence_backed_defects.observation: The 'No backups are being made' notice is outlined in --ky-accent (pixel #bf3f18 light / #f5865f dark; computed border rgb(191,63,24)) over accent-soft fill, via .dr-alert-warn at web/src/styles/theme.css:326.
evidence_backed_defects.contract: design-contract Color roles: orange is reserved for the single primary, selection and focus; status uses --ky-warning/--ky-danger with text.
evidence_backed_defects.fix: Point .dr-alert-warn at the existing warning (or danger) status alias instead of accent; no copy, route or behaviour change.
evidence_backed_defects.history: Retained from earlier rounds, not a round-7 regression; my round 6 misread it as danger.

remaining_judgment_deductions.observation: Collapsed 'Filters' is a bare triangle + 14px text with no control shape and no filled action in view (H7, A7). Natively the hit area is a 40px full-width row with a visible 2px accent focus ring, so this is visual affordance only.

Expanded phone stack (2 half + 3 full-width fields) pushes the result to the viewport bottom; Activity's continues below the fold (normal scroll). Same D7 as round 6; the rejected paired-date option is not reopened.

Refresh, Pin key and a three-button row headed 'Back up now' (same label as its button) compete with Pair (H7); unequal setup-column ends leave space under Pair (D7, overlaps the designated unequal-heights taste item).
Per-alert title emphasis (H7) and app-detail section rhythm (D7) scored lower than my round 6 on pixels that changed only in live chronology.
